fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2013 Subaru Crosstrek in the cars by owner section.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on both front headlights
Dull, flat-looking dark gray paint on the hood and front bumper with little gloss
Dust and grime on the driver's door sill and lower door area
Faded unpainted black plastic fender flares and lower body cladding
message: Hi, we saw your Crosstrek listing and it looks like a solid car. In the photos the headlights look hazy and the driver's floor mat and door sill could use a cleaning. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight restoration and a buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
